readonlyEditor: Preview mode is on; switch back to editing before saving
workspaceReadonly: SiYuan is running in read-only mode, so this file cannot be edited here
tooLarge: The file is {size}, over the {limit} MB limit of this plugin; raise the limit in the settings
restoreBody:
This file had unsaved changes when the editor was last closed.
**Ignore**: keep the stash and load the original file; you will be asked again next time
**Discard**: delete the stash and load the original file
**Restore**: load the stashed content and decide for yourself whether to save it
closeBody: {file} has unsaved changes. Save them before closing?
takeover: Take over clicks on asset text files
takeoverTip: Open links to whitelisted text files in this editor
takeoverGestureTip: Which click opens the editor. Other gestures keep SiYuan's own behaviour
previewSyTip: Choose it from a note's menu to read its .sy source file in a read-only editor
syReadonly: A previewed .sy file is read-only and cannot be edited or saved
codeBlockMenuTip: Add format and minify to a note's code block menu, acting on that block's content
extensionsTip: Only links to assets with these extensions are opened here. One per line, or separated by commas or spaces
maxSizeTip: Files larger than this are not opened here
confirmOnCloseTip: Ask before closing an editor that has unsaved changes. Closing the whole SiYuan window cannot be intercepted; unsaved changes are stashed instead
stashUnsavedTip: Keep unsaved content when an editor closes, and offer to restore it the next time the same file is opened
openModeTip: Which mode a newly opened file starts in. Preview is read-only; the button in the action bar switches back to editing at any time. Editors that are already open are unaffected
desktopFormTip: Whether a newly opened file becomes a tab or a floating window
lineNumbersTip: Whether the gutter shows line numbers
lineWrapTip: Whether content wider than the editor wraps automatically
ligaturesTip: Whether the code font's ligatures apply, such as => and !=
fontSizeTip: Font size of the editor text in px. Leave it empty to follow SiYuan and match code blocks
autocompleteTip: List the current language's keywords and words already in the document as you type. Word-level only, with no type or member completion
restoreCursorTip: Return to the previous scroll position and cursor when the same file is reopened
debugModeTip: Write detailed logs to the browser console for troubleshooting
forgetTip: Remembers the language chosen per file, the cursor position, and stashed changes
settingsFailed: Settings could not be written to the workspace
